claims.citation: The Sun (London), 13 August 1866, HMD item art0171 (Heritage Made Digital, British Library)
Lloyd's List, 9 August 1866, p. 1, col. 4 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 29 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Manhattan[?] (Br), Harris, Liverpool, Aug 8, and
Queenstown 9th, with mdse and 703[?] passengers, all well, to
Williams & Guion. 14th, lat 48 48, lon 34 20, had an accident
to machinery. 20th, lat 44 29, lon 50 13, passed several schrs
fishing; boarded schr Delos, of Plymouth, with 600 quintals
on board; in same lat and lon, saw bark Reciprocity (Br))
26th, lat 41 06, lon 67 08, passed a bark rigged steamer, bound
W; 27th, passed a brig rigged sidewheel steamer, also a
Hamburg steamer, the City of London and Denmark, all
bound E; about same time, passed ship Montgomery, from
Boston for Madras.
